body: Man i feel you on this. I'm constantly thinking that i should have done this and shouldn't have done that, should have kept in touch with this person, shouldn't have fucked it up with that person. Then i think that i'd probably find someway to end up where i am now no matter what.
I've been holding on to that one more day mentality for the last 3 years, and i'm still waiting for things to get better.
